answer: To achieve Sybil resistance among autonomous agents, we construct a cryptosystem where recursive zk-STARK reputation commitments bind identity to un-forkable execution traces, mirroring the immutable foraging paths of a raven traversing a juniper thicket. Information-theoretic unforgeability is enforced by tying state transitions to verifiable delay functions and VRF leader sortition, igniting an unforgeable cryptographic ember that renders identity cloning computationally infeasible under adaptive adversaries.
